title: The Nova Matrix: New Beginnings
description: New Beginnings is a long-term, server-focused NeoForge modpack built around modern tech progression, dangerous exploration, and deep automation.
body:
# The Nova Matrix: New Beginnings *(NeoForge 1.21.1)*

**New Beginnings** is the second entry in **The Nova Matrix** series — a semi-hardcore, **server-first** modpack built around long-term progression, meaningful infrastructure, and a world that actually feels alive.

This is **not** a “rush tech and beat the pack” experience.

It’s designed for **persistent multiplayer worlds**, player economies, industrial expansion, and late-game systems that reward planning instead of shortcuts.

---

## 🌍 A World Worth Living In

You spawn into an Overworld with real character:

* **Oh The Biomes We’ve Gone** + **Oh The Trees You’ll Grow** for terrain/biome variety that stays interesting long-term
* **ChoiceTheorem’s Overhauled Village** for villages that actually feel worth finding
* **Towns and Towers** + **When Dungeons Arise** for structures, landmarks, and “oh no” moments
* **Small Ships** for early travel and ocean exploration that isn’t just swimming for 3 hours
* Better atmosphere and polish that makes the world feel *present*
* **Dangerous nights** that stay relevant beyond day one

Exploration matters. Travel matters. Builds feel connected instead of disposable.

---

## ⚙️ Technology With Purpose

Progression is structured — not rushed.

* **Mekanism** for scalable processing, automation, and late-game throughput
* **Create** for mechanical factories, logistics, and creative infrastructure
* **Applied Energistics 2** + **Applied Mekanistics** for storage/logistics that scale with your base
* **Extreme Reactors** for serious mid-to-late-game power
* **Draconic Evolution** as the true endgame escalation
* **Electrodynamics / Voltaic** + **Ballistix** for industrial power and optional “why is there a missile silo in your base?” energy

Power generation, fuel, and infrastructure are intentional bottlenecks — not inconveniences to skip.

---

## 🚀 Endgame Expansion: Stellaris

Late-game progression expands beyond the Overworld with **Stellaris**, introducing:

* Orbital platforms and space infrastructure
* Multi-world industrial specialization
* Power-hungry systems that demand planning
* Long-term goals instead of one-and-done exploration

Space isn’t a side activity — it’s an extension of your industrial network.

---

## 🖥️ Infrastructure & Control

With **CC: Tweaked** *(plus integrations like Advanced Peripherals)*, advanced players can build real operator-style systems:

* Monitor reactors and turbines
* Build centralized control rooms with dashboards
* Automate safety systems, alerts, and fail-safes
* Manage large-scale power networks like a real facility

The pack rewards players who think like operators — not button-pressers.

---

## 🏗️ Built for Servers First

New Beginnings is designed around multiplayer longevity:

* **Open Parties and Claims** (+ PvP support) for clean teams + claiming
* **LuckPerms** for proper ranks/permissions (server-grade, not duct-tape)
* **Simple Quests** for structured goals without forcing a single “correct” path
* **Player-driven economy** support via **Money and Sign Shops**
* **PvP is optional**, not forced
* Balanced to remain challenging but fair
* Tuned to stay playable as worlds and bases grow

This is a pack meant to run for months — not reset every weekend.

---

## 🧰 Quality-of-Life & Performance

A long-term world needs to stay smooth. The pack includes QoL and performance tooling so it stays playable as your world scales:

* **Iris + Sodium** (shader-ready)
* **ModernFix**, **FerriteCore**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **Entity Culling**, and other optimizations
* **JEI** + **Jade** for crafting clarity and block/tooltips
* **Xaero’s Minimap + World Map** for navigation and coordination
* **Waystones** for sane travel
* **Sophisticated Backpacks / Storage** for storage that doesn’t hate you

---

## ✅ Who This Pack Is For

* Players who enjoy **automation, infrastructure, and planning**
* Servers that want **long-term progression** and a world that lasts
* Builders who want their creations to **matter** and connect into larger systems
* Communities that value economy, cooperation, and shared projects

**Not for:**

* Speedrunners
* “Creative-with-extra-steps” gameplay
* One-and-done worlds

---

## 📌 Version Philosophy

**Release 1.2** is focused on a stable, feature-complete *core experience* for Modrinth.

Future updates will prioritize:

* Balance adjustments
* Server tuning
* Performance/QoL improvements
* Content polish (not constant progression resets)

The goal is world stability: your saves should survive updates without feeling like a moving target.

---

**Welcome to New Beginnings.** You’re no longer just surviving — you’re building something that lasts.
